gloss: to be content; to be fully satisfied; to want for nothing

definitions.gloss: to be content; to be fully satisfied; to want for nothing
definitions.explanation: To feel complete satisfaction, with nothing lacking. Describes a deep, settled sense of fulfillment rather than momentary pleasure.

examples.japanese: {満|み}ち{足|た}りた⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満|み}ち{足|た}りる。
examples.english: Being with my family fills me with contentment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{満|み}ち{足|た}りて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We can't afford luxury, but I'm fully content with our life as it is now.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{満|み}ちる→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧ (to be full) + ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (to suffice). Most often seen in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ state, describing an ongoing condition of contentment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満|み}ち{足|た}りた⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: a contented look
- {満|み}ち{足|た}りた⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a fulfilling life
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{満|み}ち{足|た}りる: to feel fulfilled at heart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満足|まんぞく}する→満足する：22617_manzokusuru⟧: to be satisfied — more everyday and can describe satisfaction with a specific thing; {満|み}ち{足|た}りる suggests a fuller, more lasting contentment
